title: Glasswing Market
constraints: single HTML file if html stack, single component if vite

workerResult.summary: Glasswing Market — a cottagecore butterfly-trading game over 7 market days. Four glass stalls (frosted-glass cards, striped awnings, keepers, drifting prices with trend arrows, limited stock) sell 8 wing-goods with per-hue SVG butterflies. Trading: buy, sell to best bid, once-a-day haggle (charm -15% / annoy +5%), and a 3-slot villager order board paying coins + renown. Market score HUD (day, dew coins, renown, collection) tallies at finale into coins + renown×10 + collection bonus with rank titles; best persists in localStorage with save/continue. Fraunces + Karla type, parchment/sage/honey palette, fluttering butterflies, toasts, responsive at 375px. Headless smoke test: 4 stalls, 12 listings, 3 orders, buy/haggle/sell/day-advance/finale all pass, node --check clean.
